title: Schedule Menu Polish, Legal Unification & Campus Sync Protection
releaseNotes: Schedule Options Menu Fix: Eliminated the screen dimming and containing border artifact on the 3-dots schedule dropdown.
Settings Menu Streamlining: Removed the obsolete onboarding guide replay button from About & System settings.
Unified Legal & Privacy Center: Merged separate Terms of Service and Privacy Policy pages into a single tabbed dialog with direct web access.
Permanent Campus Sync Protection: Eradicated lingering backend default fallbacks in SMS, chat, feedback, and share endpoints to prevent campus reversion.
Graceful Campus State: Display 'Select Campus' instead of defaulting unassigned students to ACQ College of Ministries.
